baseline_comparison.scope: Isolated original source snapshot captured before cleanup, including the original dirty worktree. Uses same 750x750 topology, 3000/10000 QPS, warmup, heap, and 50ms gates; adds GC/safepoint diagnostics. Separate source tree; current workspace left unchanged.
baseline_comparison.result: Original source also fails the 10000 QPS client P99 50ms gate (80.966ms). The gate failure therefore exists before cleanup; this is not evidence that the latency distribution is identical after cleanup.
baseline_comparison.gc_observation: Baseline measured 10000 QPS window 12:27:37.597–12:27:47.608 contained a 118.416ms G1 young-GC pause at 12:27:45.810. This is a plausible contributor to client tail latency; not a proof of the sole cause.

remaining_validation_failure: 750P/750D BATCH at 10000 QPS exceeds the strict 50ms client P99 gate in both cleanup runs and in the original-source baseline. Server P99, throughput and 3000 QPS gates pass. The threshold has not been relaxed.
